evidence.quote: Pink Palace presents the winner of the Palme D'Or Award at the 2003 Cannes Film Festival.
It's a film about the infamous, fairly un-famous, and beloved punk rock band NOFX.
This year’s Doc'n Roll FF shorts programme is united by a distinctly punk ethos, not a genre, but an attitude.
